_comment: Trilevel self-optimization guardrail config -- see council/decisions.jsonl topic 'autonomy guardrails for self-optimizing stack' for the debate that produced this shape. Level 0 (evolve/ghscan execution) and Level 1 (independent verify+adopt) may both READ this file; only Level 1 may WRITE scorerConstraints, and nothing but a human editing this file directly may touch permanentBoundary.

scorerConstraints.qualityFloor: independent re-judge (level1-verify.js) must agree the candidate beat baseline before adoption -- a Level-0-reported win alone is never sufficient

level2.note: No durable unattended scheduler exists for this: CronCreate is session-only (dies with the session, 7-day max even if recurring), and `schedule` cloud routines run in an isolated Anthropic sandbox with no access to local files/tools. Level 2 (/council anchor audit) runs when a Claude Code session actually checks -- either the user asks, or a session start notices floorDays has elapsed.
